custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active parts, part A in category A and part B in category B, so the category A filter leaves part B out.
  • Have two inactive parts, part C in category A and part D in category B, so the category A filter leaves part D out.
  • Give parts A, B, C and D part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists them, and descriptions that run A to Z in the order part A, part B, part C, part D.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425587-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425587-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • To set a part inactive: on the Inventory page's Active tab click Search, type its part number, click its row; in Edit Inventory Part click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. The part then shows on the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Active tab lists parts A and B: 2 rows.

Step 2:

  • Only part A is listed.

Step 3:

  • Parts A and B are listed again.

Step 4:

  • The rows are ordered by Description.

Step 5:

  • The order of parts A and B reverses.

Step 6:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 7:

  • The Inactive tab lists parts C and D: 2 rows.

Step 8:

  • Only part C is listed, just as the same filter left only the category A part on the Active tab.

Step 9:

  • Parts C and D are listed again.

Step 10:

  • The rows are ordered by Description.

Step 11:

  • The order of parts C and D reverses, as it did on the Active tab.
